description: Ministry of Labour and Trade Union Relations - Award made to the Industrial Dispute between the Ceylon Mercantile Industrial & General Workers union on behalf of Mr. W. K. S. Wijeyaratne and Piramal Glass Ceylon PLC
categorisation: This gazette content publishes an arbitration award under the Industrial Disputes Act, which constitutes a legal/regulatory matter. It involves the formal publication of a legal decision regarding an industrial dispute between a workers' union and a company, made under statutory authority. The content focuses on legal proceedings, evidence analysis, and determination of rights under labor law, fitting squarely within Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory Gazettes) for legal framework and regulatory matters.
